body:
Production checkout verification complete — **no revenue claimed**.

Proof (2026-08-07 UTC):
- `GET https://api.youandinotai.com/api/v1/health` -> `200 application/json`; `db_connected=true`, `square_connected=true`, `square_signature_configured=true`.
- Registered fresh production proof account via `POST https://api.youandinotai.com/api/v1/auth/register` -> `201`, user `f546aab7-6298-437b-9eb5-9ed261448fdc`.
- Authenticated `POST https://api.youandinotai.com/api/v1/billing/checkout-link` returned `200` for all tiers:
  - founding_member: session `f59ba55d-7ff7-4130-85b0-4d979ccd07ea`, `https://square.link/u/QmmJHq1q`
  - 3_month: session `a526ff9f-300f-4a81-bb96-7d5a9998ace0`, `https://square.link/u/NBbOCa7C`
  - 12_month: session `7d68b337-1723-4547-a2b2-88c6fc5b374e`, `https://square.link/u/LP7dok6l`
  - royalty: session `6306a1e1-6163-4a7f-9a7d-c01e2cae7c0f`, `https://square.link/u/b61J9gGA`
- Each Square URL -> `200`, redirects to `https://checkout.square.site/merchant/ML3C7FMTQS5KX/order/...`, title `YouAndiNotAi`.
- CORS preflight from `Origin: https://youandinotai.com` to production checkout endpoint -> `200`, allows `authorization,content-type` and `POST`.

Found/fixed live browser blocker: public Vite dev deployment had no `VITE_API_URL`, so frontend API client called same-origin `/api/v1`; `POST https://youandinotai.com/api/v1/billing/checkout-link` returned `404` from Express. Commit `1171b88e` adds public-host fallback to `https://api.youandinotai.com/api/v1`. Verified served source now contains fallback. `npm run build` passes.

Receipt/order telemetry truth:
- `GET https://api.youandinotai.com/api/v1/health/webhooks` -> `200 {"webhooks":[]}`.
- `GET https://api.youandinotai.com/api/v1/health/allocations` -> `200 {"allocations":[]}`.
- `GET https://api.youandinotai.com/api/v1/health/allocations/summary` -> all customer/test payment counts and gross cents `0`.
- No card charged; therefore no receipt/order/payment proof and no revenue claim.
- Affiliate `?ref=` is generated by `PreOrder.tsx`, but repo has no capture/attribution path tying ref to checkout/payment telemetry. Exact blocker: referral attribution not implemented; paid webhook cannot currently prove affiliate source.

Remaining proof requires authorized real buyer completing Square payment, then matching `payment.completed` webhook/payment ID, allocation row, and Square receipt. Do not run synthetic webhook or charge without authorization.

Next critical CTO work: verify production checkout telemetry end-to-end. Provide test order/payment event path, webhook/log evidence, and explicit separation of test vs real receipts. Never claim revenue from test transactions.
